rules.title: Annual General Adjustment capped at 5%
rules.requirement: The Rent Board sets the Annual General Adjustment for fully covered units by a CPI-based formula, but the AGA cannot exceed 5% in any year. Landlords with banked (unused) AGAs from prior years may still raise rent by more than 5% up to the rent ceiling.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered units, e.g. most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 and single-family homes with tenancies that began prior to 1996. New construction units (certificate of occupancy issued after 1980), most single-family homes and most condominiums are only partially covered.
rules.exemptions: Partially covered units have no rent ceiling. Units where the tenant shares kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord are exempt only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy. Banked AGAs may exceed 5%.
rules.extraction_note: Measure BB was passed by voters in the November 2024 election. No exact adoption date or effective date is given. The page says 'built before 1980', which is recorded as year built 1979 or earlier. The page also says new construction is units with a certificate of occupancy issued after 1980.

rules.title: Government-owned or -subsidized units brought under Rent Ordinance
rules.requirement: Government-owned or -subsidized units (e.g. Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC) must be registered as fully or partially covered. Fully covered ones have a rent ceiling, with increases limited by the Annual General Adjustment.
rules.key_value: Subsidized units fully or partially covered depending on unit type
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: Government-owned or -subsidized rental units become either fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.coverage_text: Subsidized units are fully or partially covered depending on unit type. Section 202, Section 811, and HUD-insured or HUD-held projects with Rent Supplement, Loan Management Set Aside or project-based Section 8 are partially covered regardless of unit type.
rules.exemptions: Units where federal law, state law or administrative regulation prohibits rent control are only partially covered.
rules.interaction: Coverage depends on whether federal law, state law or administrative regulation exempts the unit from local rent control.
rules.extraction_note: No effective date is stated. The built cutoff reflects the fully covered multifamily category ('built before 1980').

rules.title: Capital improvement rent increase petitions limited to completed work
rules.requirement: Landlords may petition for rent increases only for completed capital improvements. They can no longer get preliminary authorization for planned improvements.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: Landlords can only file a petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements (they can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements).
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered rental units subject to rent ceilings

rules.title: Nonpayment eviction threshold of one month Fair Market Rent
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment only if the tenant owes rent at least equal to one month of HUD Fair Market Rent for an equivalent unit in the Oakland-Fremont metro area. FMR is for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.key_value: Rental debt of at least one month's HUD FMR (Oakland-Fremont)
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance
rules.exemptions: Exempt units, e.g. a shared kitchen or bath with a landlord who lived on the property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.extraction_note: No effective date is stated. Measure BB passed in the November 2024 election.

rules.title: No eviction for refusing to sign a substantially similar lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease when a fixed-term lease expires. This eliminates a former just cause.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance

rules.title: Stricter requirements for lease-violation evictions
rules.requirement: Evictions for breach of a material lease term require a mutually agreed term, a breach causing substantial actual damage, and proof that the tenant's behavior was unreasonable. The prior notice to cease must specify the term and describe the violation and harm.
rules.key_value: Actual harm and unreasonable behavior required
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant’s behavior was unreasonable, and may not evict tenants for lease breaches that do not cause the landlord any actual harm.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance

rules.title: Eviction notice content and Rent Board filing within three business days
rules.requirement: Termination notices must state that advice is available from the Rent Board and give its counseling phone number and website. Copies of termination notices, notices to quit and summons and complaints must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of service.
rules.key_value: File with Rent Board within 3 business days
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance

rules.title: Mandatory annual inflation adjustment of owner move-in relocation assistance
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must adjust owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts for inflation every year.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance, as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.coverage_text: Owner move-in evictions of covered tenancies
rules.extraction_note: No relocation dollar amounts or effective date are stated.
